newsitem.title: USA: CSCE sugar ends up, at top of range in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: CSCE sugar ends up, at top of range in thin trade.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed a lightly-traded session firmer, having pierced an upside target near the close.
The March contract overcame the 10.75 hurdle in late-session trade but slid back to settle at 10.75, up 0.06, traded 10.76 to 10.70. The back months finished 0.07 to 0.04 higher.
Activity was slim with volume estimated at only 4,634 lots.
Floor sources said trade is likely to remain equally dull through the holiday week. CSCE sugar futures will stop trading at 1120 EST/1620 GMT Tuesday, and resume trade Thursday.
Resistance in March was pegged at 10.89 cents, the recent high made Dec 19, and then at 11.05 cents, where aggressive fund buying is expected to emerge, dealers said.
Firm support remained at 10.50 cents in March.
